This complex is further targeted by Galacturonic Acid and Robustadial B, both of which have been shown to interact with HEp-2 cells. The presence of multiple targets, including a DNA methyltransferase complex, indicates a potential role in regulating gene expression and cellular processes in HEp-2 cells. The varying scores across the paths suggest that the relationship is supported by multiple lines of evidence, though the strength of each pathway may differ. The integration of these findings implies that Abyssinone I may influence HEp-2 cells through a complex network of molecular interactions, potentially affecting cellular functions and responses.
